article.title: La Bola Negra: A Revolutionary Queer Masterpiece
article.author: Javier Sethness
article.content: La bola negra (“The Black Ball”), the new hit film by Spanish auteurs Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo, is a true masterpiece that centers queer love, anti-fascism, and historical memory. The post La Bola Negra: A Revolutionary Queer Masterpiece appeared first on New Politics .
